# Bricks

> GTA real estate listing media — HDR photography, licensed drone, floor plans, with optional 3D virtual tours. Book a shoot in 24–48h, serving agents at Canada's leading brokerages and REITs.

Bricks is a real estate media company operating in the Greater Toronto Area (GTA), Ontario, Canada. Agents and brokerages book listing photo/video/drone shoots online; Bricks dispatches a vetted local photographer and delivers edited media within 24–48 hours.

## Core pages

- [Pricing](https://www.brxs.ca/pricing): Package and à-la-carte pricing for HDR photography, drone, floor plans, twilight, and 3D virtual tours.
- [Book a shoot](https://www.brxs.ca/book): Online booking flow with MLS auto-fill and instant pricing.
- [Gallery](https://www.brxs.ca/gallery): Sample listing photography and video from the Bricks photographer network.
- [Service areas](https://www.brxs.ca/service-areas): GTA neighbourhoods and municipalities covered.
- [Photographers](https://www.brxs.ca/photographers): Independent contractor network — apply to shoot for Bricks.
- [About](https://www.brxs.ca/about): Company background.
- [Contact](https://www.brxs.ca/contact): Get in touch.
